perception.note: Low light vision, Scent 60ft imprecise, branchlocation (precise) 30 feet

generalAbilities.name: Branchlocation
generalAbilities.description: The hippopotamus topiary can tap its branches together and use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range.

offensiveAbilities.name: Absorb Water
offensiveAbilities.description: When in water or exposed to a water effect, the hippopotamus loses its weakness to fire until the start of its next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Jaw Crush
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The hippopotamus topiary has a creature Grabbed

Effect It forcefully bites down on whatever is in its mouth, dealing 6d8 Piercing Damage damage with a Basic DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a critical failure, creatures take 1d8 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pruning
offensiveAbilities.description: The hippopotamus topiary twists and contorts its shape, shedding branches and leaves as needed to change into a topiary of a Medium or smaller animal. Until the next time it acts, the topiary has an automatic result of 43 for Deception checks and DCs to appear as a mundane topiary.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swamp Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Sickened 2 (1 day)

Stage 3 sickened 2 and 1d8 Persistent,bleed Damage damage (1 day)

Stage 4 sickened 2, Drained 1, and 2d8 Persistent,bleed Damage damage (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

offensiveAbilities.name: Walk Through Plants
offensiveAbilities.description: The hippopotamus topiary ignores difficult terrain caused by dense vegetation.
